private_lines.Amelia: You live in Wellington with your partner and young son, teach a Year 4 class five days a week, and do most of your marking and planning in the evenings.
private_lines.Peter: You live on your own in Wellington, teach music across the school, and play in a community brass band on weeknights.
private_lines.Priya: You live on your own in Wellington, support children with additional needs in small groups, and go to the gym before school most mornings.
private_lines.Ethan: You live in Wellington in a shared flat with other people, teach a junior class, and study part time for a masters degree in the evenings.
private_lines.Carol: You live on your own in Wellington, coordinate the school library and run the reading programme, and volunteer at a community garden on weekends.
